title: Light Peruvian Sweetcorn Fried Rice
description: A quick and easy Peruvian dish featuring sweetcorn and fried rice, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this vegan-friendly recipe is a yeasty and shattering delight.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the sweetcorn kernels and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet or wok, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir in the soy sauce, turmeric, salt, and pepper, and cook for about 2 minutes, until the rice is well coated.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and serve immediately.
Garnish with chopped scallions or cilantro, if desired.
